01 / PROBLEM STATEMENT & MOTIVATION
The 1,000-Meter Subsurface Blind Spot in Ocean Observation
CRITICAL NATIONAL CHALLENGE THEME: SURAKSHIT BHARAT
1. Cyclone Rapid Intensification (RI)
Satellites only see surface skin (SST). Warm skin (29°C) that is shallow quickly cools under hurricane churn. However, deep subsurface warm pools (D26 > 80m) trigger sudden, catastrophic cyclone explosive intensification within 24–48 hours, catching coastal disaster authorities unprepared.
₹10,000+ Crores
Annual coastal destruction risk along Odisha, AP, TN, and West Bengal coasts.
2. Naval Sonar & Acoustic Shadow Zones
Active naval sonar depends on Sonic Layer Depth (SLD). Below SLD, sound rays refract downward creating acoustic shadow zones where hostile submarines navigate completely undetected. Maritime patrol aircraft (P-8I, MQ-9B) waste ₹12L per flight dropping sonobuoys blindly.
72% Sensor Waste
Disposable sonobuoys ($800–$2,400 each) dropped blindly into acoustic shadows.
3. In-Situ Observation Sparsity
Robotic ARGO profiling floats provide vertical accuracy but are critically sparse: only ~30 active buoys exist across the 2.2M km² Bay of Bengal, surfacing only once every 10 days. Hydrographic research vessel cruises (ORV Sagar Nidhi) cost ₹15–25 Lakhs per sea-day.
₹25 Lakhs / Day
Prohibitive cost of physical research vessel cruises for deep ocean soundings.
THE OCEANEMBED PARADIGM SHIFT
Instead of deploying hundreds of millions of dollars in hardware buoys, OceanEmbed inverts readily available 2D satellite surface observations (SST, SLA altimetry, sea surface salinity, wind stress curl) into the full 0–1,000m continuous 3D temperature and acoustic sound-speed profile using physics-regularized deep learning.

03 / CORE TECHNOLOGY & AI FORMULATION
Spatiotemporal ConvNeXt + Causal ConvGRU + NeOF
PHYSICS-INFORMED NEURAL OPERATOR 1,687,217 MODEL PARAMETERS
1. Multi-Modal Surface Telemetry Ingestion
Fuses 4 daily satellite observations: L4 Foundation SST, Altimetric Sea Level Anomaly (SLA), Sea Surface Salinity (SSS), and 10m scatterometry wind stress curl + geostrophic surface currents (OSCAR).
2. 7-Day Causal ConvGRU Temporal Memory
Maintains internal memory over (t − 6 to t) causal sequence. Explicitly resolves propagating equatorial Kelvin waves and westward Rossby waves (1.5–2.5 m/s) governing thermocline heave.
3. Continuous Neural Ocean Field (NeOF) Coordinate Decoder
Reconstructs temperature as a continuous coordinate implicit field T̂(x, y, z) using multi-frequency sinusoidal Fourier positional encodings, enabling queries at arbitrary vertical depth resolutions.
4. Evidential Uncertainty Head
Predicts localized epistemic variance σ²(x, y, z) alongside temperature, alerting operators when cloud-masking degrades satellite confidence.
Physics-Informed Multi-Objective Loss Formulation
ℒtotal = ℒHuber(T̂, T) + λsmooth ‖∂²T̂/∂z²‖² + λsteric |ηsteric − SLA| + λNLL ℒevidential
• Vertical Curvature Penalty (λsmooth): Enforces fluid mechanical vertical stability, completely suppressing unphysical oscillatory ripples.
• Steric Sea Level Constraint (λsteric): Integrates thermal expansion ∫ α(T) dz to ensure vertical profile column expansion exactly matches observed altimetric SLA.
• Evidential NLL (λNLL): Directly calibrates predictive uncertainty for defense and disaster risk planning.

05 / DEFENSE & MARITIME SECURITY APPLICATION
Tactical Naval Acoustics & Submarine Shadow Zones
INDIAN NAVY MARITIME OPERATIONS ANTI-SUBMARINE WARFARE (ASW)
Mackenzie Sound Speed Profile Formulation
Sound velocity in seawater is governed by temperature, salinity, and pressure. OceanEmbed evaluates the empirical 9-term Mackenzie (1981) equation at every vertical depth coordinate:
C(T, S, z) = 1448.96 + 4.591 T − 0.05304 T² + 2.374×10⁻⁴ T³ + 1.340(S − 35) + 0.0163 z + …
Sonic Layer Depth (SLD) Duct
50.0 meters
Near-surface sound speed maximum (1545.6 m/s) creates an upper acoustic duct trapping active sonar waves horizontally.
Submarine Shadow Zone
Below 50 m
Negative thermal gradient bends sound rays downward, creating blind zones where submarines conceal from surface ships.
